about_the_game:
Kaal Yoddha

Kaal Yoddha is an action-adventure game where you play as Prince Avyaan, a brave warrior and skilled archer on a cursed island plagued by evil demons. Uncover secrets of ancient masks, master bow-and-arrow combat, and face epic combat in a dark mythic kingdom of ancient power and fierce warriors.

An action-adventure game rooted in the mythic heritage of ancient India. Play as Prince Avyaan—a skilled archer and brave warrior—summoned to a cursed island filled with evil demons and dark forces that threaten the legacy of a lost kingdom.

A Looming Curse

  • Explore eerie forests, decaying temples, and hidden caverns where reality blurs into mystery. Uncover secrets of ancient relics, swords, and legends tied to a forgotten past.

  • Face monsters, devils, and dark powers that challenge your survival in this single-player story-driven experience.

Prince Avyaan’s Path

  • Brave the unknown and confront spreading corruption consuming everything in its path.

  • Descend into dark depths to battle demonic forces and reclaim your lost honor with sword and bow.

Key Features

Dynamic Combat: Engage in dynamic combat as a fierce fighter. Use your bow and arrow or sword to strike enemies from near and far. Adapt your fighting style to survive relentless attacks.

  • Mystery Unveiled: Unravel the mystery of the island through environmental storytelling, ancient murals, and cryptic notes.

  • Parkour & Exploration: Scale cliffs and navigate treacherous terrain with parkour skills, solving puzzles to progress deeper.

  • Epic Battles: Test your skills against towering monsters and deadly demons standing as a testament to the curse’s power.

Will you survive the dark trials and uphold the legacy of your people? Take up your bow, sword, and courage to write your own legend in this thrilling action-adventure game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence and blood.
